suppressions.description: Addresses to suppress, at most 1000 per request.

identifier.description: The email address to suppress. Matched case-insensitively.

reason.description:
Why the address is suppressed. `bounce` blocks every email, transactional included, because the address can't receive mail. `complaint` (the recipient reported spam) and `manual` block marketing email only. Defaults to `manual`.

* `bounce` - Bounce
* `complaint` - Complaint
* `manual` - Manual
